## Why this name

- Three modes assign cursor x from the same index: mode 0 = index - width/2 (centre), 1 = index - width (right), 2 = index (left)
- Derives width from TextMeasureWidth(data, unk8C, unkA0, unk9C) then tail-calls the glyph walker
- Bounds-checks index >= unk98 (text area width) and returns without drawing
